about: Official schedule changes the news feed doesn't carry yet (e.g. notices posted only on X). scripts/update-schedule.mjs applies each entry to the event with that id and name. `feed` is what the feed gave when the entry was written (Americas ISO time, or null); once the feed gives something else, the feed wins and the entry is skipped and reported, so delete it then. Dates are server time (the same wall-clock time on each server). `note` is added to the event's details.
